name: Opposite-Pendant Class
definition: In coordinate order $x_3x_2x_1x_0$, the six-word class $\{0000,0001,0010,0011,0101,1010\}$: a square on $x_0,x_1$ with pendant vertices attached at opposite corners in directions $x_2,x_3$.
properties: It is ample and spread ample, has diameter four, and is not maximum. It witnesses that spread ample and maximum classes are incomparable.
